uutiset.s: A slew of leveraged ETFs tied to SpaceX launched soon after its public debut, but only one managed to attract meaningful assets. uutiset.t: Fed Minutes Leave Door Open to Larger December Rate Hike
uutiset.s: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee’s Oct. 27-28 meeting show nearly all Federal Reserve officials agreed they would likely have to raise interest rates “in the months ahead” to return inflation to their 2% target in a timely manner. Michael McKee reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Fed’s Barr Says Higher Rates Are Likely ‘Appropriate’
uutiset.s: Federal Reserve Governor Michael Barr says higher interest rates would likely be appropriate to help tame inflation that continues to squeeze American households. He speaks at the New York Fed's Making Missing Markets event. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: US Carrier Leaves Persian Gulf for Japan, Leaving Two in Region
uutiset.s: One of three US aircraft carrier strike groups in the Persian Gulf region to enforce the naval blockade against Iran has left the region and is likely returning to its home port, according to two US officials.

uutiset.s: Anthropic PBC is preparing to price what could be the biggest IPO of all time, and the numbers are startling. The AI lab is set to challenge SpaceX for the record, which Elon Musk’s rocket and satellite firm claimed in June with a first-time share sale that rocked markets.

uutiset.t: Kalshi Turns to Compute Desk in Renewed Push for GPU Futures
uutiset.s: Kalshi Inc. is working with index provider Compute Desk to launch futures contracts tied to the cost of computing power used for artificial intelligence, pushing into what exchanges see as a potentially lucrative new asset class, according to people familiar with the matter.

uutiset.t: Aclara CEO Says Brazil Incentives Key as Firm Weighs Rare-Earth Plant Investment
uutiset.s: The head of Aclara Resources Inc. says Brazil needs to offer more incentives to miners as the firm weighs a future rare-earth separation plant in the largest South American nation.

uutiset.t: Bank of Canada Says April Scenario Analysis Telegraphed Hike
uutiset.s: A Bank of Canada official says policymakers are publishing scenario analyses to help market participants see potential paths for interest rates amid more frequent shocks.

uutiset.t: Newsmax Sues to Block Fox From Integrating With Roku
uutiset.s: Conservative news channel Newsmax Inc. filed a lawsuit seeking to block rival broadcaster Fox Corp. from integrating the TV streaming assets of Roku Inc., arguing the $22 billion merger would hurt competition.

uutiset.t: Chicago’s Third CFO This Year Saw Red Flags Before Exit
uutiset.s: The sudden departure of Chicago’s third chief financial officer in a year came after she repeatedly raised concerns about budgeting practices, including inconsistent deficit calculations.

uutiset.t: New York MTA’s Budget Risks $1 Billion Shortfall in 2030
uutiset.s: New York City’s transit system is projecting a nearly $1 billion budget gap in 2030 as increasing healthcare and fuel costs outpace its revenue growth.
